title: DACH Campaign and Events Manager
description:
OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leader in full stack automation fabric solutions for mission-critical business processes. With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in the transformative power of automation. Our unparalleled solutions empower you to orchestrate, manage and monitor your workflows across any application, service or server — in the cloud or on premises — with confidence and control.

Redwood’s global team of automation experts and customer success engineers provide solutions and world-class support designed to give you the freedom and time to imagine and define your future. Get out of the weeds and see the forest, with Redwood Software.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team. One Redwood
  • Make Your Own Weather
  • Obsess over Customer Success
  • Work the Problem
  • Be Curious
  • Own the Outcome
  • Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a DACH Campaign and Events Manager, you will be responsible for leading Redwood's regional marketing strategy across the DACH market by localizing global campaigns, driving demand generation, supporting strategic partnerships, and collaborating closely with sales and global marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth and strengthen Redwood's presence in the region.

  • Localize Redwood's global marketing programs for the DACH region across inbound, outbound, and event channels.
  • Drive regional demand generation initiatives that build pipeline and support sales targets.
  • Execute field marketing programs in close partnership with regional sales leadership.
  • Support Redwood's SAP partnership within the DACH region.
  • Adapt marketing content and messaging to resonate with German-speaking audiences.
  • Partner with global event teams to coordinate Redwood's presence at key events across Europe and the UK.
  • Manage regional digital marketing campaigns, including localization, execution, and performance tracking.
  • Analyze campaign performance and optimize regional marketing programs for continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, ABM, Digital Marketing, and Content teams to deliver cohesive customer experiences.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • Native German speaker with fluent English communication skills.
  • 3+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing; enterprise software experience preferred.
  • Strong experience in demand generation, field marketing, and event marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with digital marketing and content localization.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while collaborating effectively with global teams.
  • Experience partnering closely with sales teams and adapting messaging to regional audiences.
  • Willingness to travel for events throughout Europe and the UK.

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. Location This is a full-time position based at our HQ in Munich or Cologne. About the role You solve the hard technical problems on live systems. Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right. That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you. Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one. Stabilising accounts When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is. Taking effort out permanently Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly. You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap. You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you. You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging. What you'll do Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause. Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic. Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering. Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly. Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants. Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities. Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once. Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone. Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function. Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations. What we're really looking for The following key attributes ensure success in this role: Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why. Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is. Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you. Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving. Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster. Stabilizer Under Pressure : An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence What you'll bring Master's degree in a STEM field: computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, physics or similar. Strong candidates from a related field are welcome to make their case. 3+ years in a technical customer-facing role: application support at depth, technical consulting, solution engineering, integration engineering or equivalent. Demonstrable debugging ability across systems, not only within one. APIs, data mapping, interfaces, logs. Comfortable with data. SQL or equivalent, and the instinct to check rather than assume. German and English, both fluent. This is a hard requirement. Our customers work in German every day and our internal work runs in English. Nice to have: ERP experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or similar, scripting in any language, or exposure to workflow automation and process mining. What you'll get The hard problems, not the queue. Influence on the product, with a direct line to Engineering and Product. Room to shape the function, since the practice is still being built. Real growth – the path from here leads into Consulting, technical leadership within Customer Success, or Product. Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option programme. Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators. Visits & offsites – including collaborative team offsites. Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact. Genuine interest in enterprise software, AI, and how large organisations actually run. Nice to have, not required: first exposure to ERP systems, SQL, APIs, or process modelling. We tell you early and honestly whether that conversation is coming. What you'll get Real responsibility from week three, not shadowing. A steep learning curve on live enterprise systems. Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished. Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions. Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack. A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. When you encounter a blocker, you investigate, communicate, and find another path forward without waiting to be managed. Strong product and technical judgment. You care about what should be built, how it should feel, and whether it actually solves the problem. You can distinguish between problems that need a sophisticated system and problems that need a simple, well-executed solution. Experience building with LLMs or other applied AI systems in production. An understanding of the challenges behind reliable AI products: evaluation, context, retrieval, model behavior, latency, cost, observability, and failure modes. Clear, proactive communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment. Care for software craftsmanship without losing sight of momentum and customer outcomes. Our AI systems use foundation models from multiple providers alongside the AI SDK, Typesense, and Laminar for search, agent workflows, evaluations, and observability. You don’t need experience with everything we use. We care more about strong fundamentals, relevant product experience, and your ability to learn quickly. Taken ownership of a major product or technical area with limited oversight. Improved how we build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered functionality. Earned the trust of the team through reliable execution and clear communication. Helped us make better product and technical decisions beyond your immediate projects. Our interview process We want the process to be useful, respectful, and representative of how we actually work. We don’t use take-home challenges or algorithmic whiteboard interviews. A technical walkthrough of a project you know deeply, focused on the decisions and trade-offs you made. A collaborative product and technical problem-solving session with members of the team. A paid work trial based on a realistic problem, which can be completed flexibly around your current commitments. References and offer. We aim to complete the process within one to two weeks. What we offer Competitive salary and equity in a Series A company. Remote-first work with the option to work together in Berlin if you are local.
